name: Monkalicious
summary:
Welcome to Monkalicious!

Monkalicious is a game where everyone can come together to have a fun experience. Monkalicious provides game modes and experiences for players to interact with each other and have the most important thing, fun. Everyone is welcomed in the game.

Monkalicious has many game modes for the players to try out.

The game has a shop for players so that you can buy cosmetics to deck out your avatar with whatever you desire.
